findings.place: Separate irregular enclosure around the cancelled opening
findings.ink: Three distinct contour runs surround the cancelled passage. The long upper stroke crosses the first line and ends freely at right. The left upright starts below it and ends in a short lower hook. A separate stepped lower/right contour starts after l'application, curls beneath the map, rises beside J into the notch and extends right below tore) alors. White intervals separate the runs. The independent underline under l'application, J and the full rightward map head are retained. The oblique cancellation strokes are drawn within this reconstruction, but macro-versus-hatching is not charged as an additional discrepancy: H explicitly describes oblique cancellation. Its uncertain cat. concerns the text inside the same block, not the enclosure. The enclosure discrepancy itself has no H doubt marker; the unrelated uncertain cat. inside the block is not treated as marking the contour.

findings.ink: A descending left attachment lies immediately before the baseline Gamma-prime, then turns into a long thin sweep beneath the whole inserted condition. The line has no visible conventional head. The old crop cuts its far-right continuation. The one new narrow crop shows a thin grey continuation reaching the paper edge, where its last extent is not securely separable from the crease; only the definite sweep is rendered and no shaped terminal is supplied.

It crosses the tall h without deleting hom. There is no separately drawn arrowhead; both witnesses preserve the added words but omit this physical stroke.

A narrow white interval separates that end from the right-facing two-part chevron: the upper leg is short and nearly upright, and the lower leg is oblique. The shaft and head are therefore drawn as separate paths, retaining the same rightward direction. The lower cancelled map has a joined full head and remains unchanged. The already accepted E/X codomain and vertical-offset corrections are preserved.

notes:
The second reading leaves the words, formula symbols, indices, source-mark decisions and all prior substantive readings intact. It adds the three separately ended strokes of the opening cancellation enclosure, while retaining the independent l'application underline and the cancelled X(Q-bar) to J map. The two short relation diagrams remain in tikz-cd; the map inside the cancellation reconstruction is likewise typeset in tikz-cd. Physical oblique cancellation is preserved with the enclosure, without a separate error claim for the deletion macro versus drawn hatching.

Two above-line insertions have definite lower leaders: the xi condition before Gamma-prime and germe d' before hom. The xi leader's far-right grey continuation reaches the paper edge and partly merges with a crease; its exact endpoint stays unresolved, and no head/upcurl is invented. The live upper replacement map has a detached chevron, while the lower cancelled map retains its connected full head. The script E objects and all four arrows of diagram (10), including its upward hook and phi_xi^t label, are unchanged.

The tiny close pair of points upper-left of phi in (10), the unrelated dash above E and the dot above the horizontal shaft have no secure punctuation, label or route attachment and are much finer than the writing. They are treated as incidental specks under the supplied error sheet, not as a colon or new uncertain graphic. The dark oblique blemish left of diagram (9) likewise has no diagram attachment. The preferred abbreviations autom and Soulignons remain uncertain at the compressed/clipped bottom edge; no expansion or lost lower strokes are supplied. This was a visual collation; no independent mathematical proof is claimed.
